title: 🪞 Perfectly Symmetric Tree
description: ✅ Both subtrees mirror each other in values and structure.

title: 💔 Asymmetric Tree
description: ❌ Identical values in non-mirrored positions break symmetry.

title: 🌱 Single-Node Tree
description: ✅ A root without children is symmetric.

title: ⚖️ Unequal Child Values
description: 🔍 Different left and right child values make the tree asymmetric.

title: 🍃 Symmetric Tree with Missing Nodes
description: 🪞 Missing children occur in corresponding mirrored positions.

title: 🧩 Same Values, Different Structure
description: 🚫 The child nodes are positioned identically rather than as mirror images.

title: 🔢 Negative and Zero Values
description: ✅ Symmetry holds with negative values and zero.

title: 🌳 Deep Symmetric Tree
description: 💪 Symmetry is preserved across multiple levels.

title: 🚨 Deep Asymmetry
description: 🔍 A deeper structural mismatch causes the tree to fail symmetry.

title: 🌱 Minimum Tree
description: ✅ A tree containing only the root is symmetric.

title: 🪞 Two Mirrored Children
description: ✅ Equal left and right children form a symmetric tree.

title: ❌ Unequal Root Children
description: ⚖️ Different child values violate symmetry.

title: 🍃 Both Children Missing
description: ✅ Two missing children preserve symmetry.

title: 🧩 Left Child Only
description: 🚫 A left child without a matching right child breaks symmetry.

title: 🧩 Right Child Only
description: 🚫 A right child without a matching left child breaks symmetry.

title: 🔄 Mirrored Grandchildren
description: 🪞 Matching grandchildren occupy opposite positions.

title: 💔 Same Values, Wrong Positions
description: 🔍 Equal values cannot compensate for incorrect mirrored positions.

title: 🌳 Symmetric Zigzag
description: ↔️ Opposing zigzag branches form mirror images.

title: 🚧 One-Sided Zigzag
description: ❌ A zigzag branch without its mirror makes the tree asymmetric.

title: 🔢 Negative Root and Children
description: ✅ Negative node values do not affect mirror symmetry.

title: 🎯 Zero Versus Negative One
description: 🔍 Even a small value difference breaks symmetry.

title: 🔝 Maximum Positive Values
description: ✅ Symmetry holds at the maximum allowed node value.

title: 🔻 Minimum Negative Values
description: ✅ Symmetry holds at the minimum allowed node value.

title: 🌲 Deep Mirrored Branches
description: 💪 Multiple levels of mirrored nodes remain symmetric.

title: 🕵️ Deep Value Mismatch
description: ❌ A single mismatched value deep in the tree breaks symmetry.

title: 🧱 Deep Structural Mismatch
description: 🚫 A missing node in a mirrored position breaks symmetry.

title: 🔁 Repeated Node Values
description: ✅ Repeated values are symmetric when the structure mirrors correctly.

title: ⚠️ Repeated Values, Asymmetric Structure
description: 🔍 Equal values alone cannot establish structural symmetry.

title: 🌿 Asymmetric at the First Level
description: ❌ Different outer grandchildren immediately break symmetry.
